items.name: AudioPeak Sound+ — Monthly Replacement Parts Plan (ear tips, cushions, annual cable credit)

orderRecord.orderNotes: Monthly recurring plan tied to the cardholder's ProSilence ANC Headphones purchase. Cardholder signed up [6 months before the disputed charge]. The disputed charge covers the final billing cycle's replacement-parts shipment.
